definitions.gloss: study book; learning guide; educational workbook
definitions.explanation: A book designed for self-study or supplementary learning on a particular subject, typically containing explanations, exercises, and practice problems. Distinguished from classroom textbooks by being geared toward independent study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a kanji study book.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: This study book is easy to understand even for beginners.

examples.english: Numerous English study books line the language section of the bookstore.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ ('study; learning') and ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ ('book; written work'). The suffix ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ forms many book-type compounds: ⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧ ('reference book'), ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧ ('textbook'), ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧ ('dictionary').

USAGE:
- Common in bookstores, where sections are labeled by type: {学習書|がくしゅうしょ}, ⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧, ⟦{問題集|もんだいしゅう}→問題集：09602_mondaishuu⟧ ('problem sets').
- Covers a wide range from children's workbooks to adult self-study guides on languages, qualifications, and professional skills.
- More formal than ⟦ドリル→ドリル：11148_doriru⟧ ('drill book') or ⟦テキスト→テキスト：01469_tekisuto⟧ ('text'), but less formal than {学術書|がくじゅつしょ} ('academic publication').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{語学|ごがく}→語学：02770_gogaku⟧{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}: language study book
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧{学習書|がくしゅうしょ}: kanji study book
- {学習書|がくしゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a study book
- {学習書|がくしゅうしょ}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: study book section (in a bookstore)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧: textbook — the official book used in school classes, as opposed to supplementary study material
- ⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧: reference book; study aid — supplementary material for exam preparation
- ⟦{問題集|もんだいしゅう}→問題集：09602_mondaishuu⟧: problem collection; workbook — focused on practice exercises and questions
- ⟦テキスト→テキスト：01469_tekisuto⟧: text; textbook — loanword used casually for any study material, especially in language schools
